Larva failed to pupate through Cocoon to AdultWarrior
triage_diagnosis:
Root Cause: In ColonyXenobiologySystem::Update(), stage transitions were executed using a single switch statement per tick. When a large delta time (e.g. 8.2s covering two incubation cycles) was passed, the progress was reset to 0.0 upon reaching Cocoon, losing leftover accumulated delta progress and preventing the specimen from completing pupation to AdultWarrior in that step.

Minimal Repair:
1. Replace the single-switch block with a while (sp.m_fIncubationProgress >= 1.0f) cascade.
2. Deduct 1.0f per transition (m_fIncubationProgress -= 1.0f) so large delta times cascade cleanly across sequential pupation metamorphosis stages.
